footer.startProject: Let's scale your business, or build one

home.metaDescription: Software engineer building websites, apps and desktop software for businesses. See the projects, services and prices, then discuss your project.

referral.title: Bring a project. Share the reward.
referral.body: Know a business that needs a website, an app or desktop software? Introduce us. When the project goes ahead under the offer terms, you get a reward.

contact.title: Let's scale your business, or build one.
contact.body: Tell me what your business needs. I'll reply with questions, a plan and an estimate.

about.metaDescription: Who builds your software: background, skills and the way each project is planned, built and reviewed.
about.title: About me

whatIBuild.title: What I build
whatIBuild.websitesBody: Landing pages, business sites, online shops and booking platforms. Fast, clear, and easy for you to update.
whatIBuild.appsBody: Web and mobile-friendly applications for shops, companies and restaurants, built around the tasks your customers and team repeat every day.
whatIBuild.softwareBody: Programs for shops, cafés, restaurants and offices: sales, stock, orders and the daily records your business runs on.
whatIBuild.intro: Planned around how your business works, and built to be easy to run.

howIWork.title: How I work
howIWork.understandBody: We talk about your business, your customers and the problem you want solved.
howIWork.planBody: You get a written scope: features, timeline and price, before any work starts.
howIWork.buildBody: I build in steps and show you progress you can click through, not just screenshots.
howIWork.reviewBody: We test it together against the agreed scope and fix what doesn't match.
howIWork.improveBody: After launch, bugs in the delivered scope get fixed. New ideas get their own estimate.

cta.title: Let's scale your business, or build one.

stack.title: My stack, as a periodic table.
stack.intro: Hover or tap a tile to see it. Pick a family to light it up.

projects.metaDescription: Websites, apps and desktop software: each project with its goal, features, technologies and current status.
projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Each project shows its real status. Concept images are labelled as concepts.
projects.empty: No projects in this category yet.

imageNote.CONCEPT: Images marked as concept are visual explorations, not final screenshots.
imageNote.DEMO: Images show a demo build, not the live product.

detail.ctaTitle: Let's scale your business, or build one.
detail.dashboardIntro: Every icon has a job. Hover or tap a number to see what it does for the business.

pricing.metaDescription: Websites, apps and desktop software for businesses, with starting prices, what's included, and how domain, hosting and maintenance work.
pricing.title: Services & Pricing
pricing.intro: Every project is planned around your business and its scope. These are the services, followed by how pricing works.
pricing.pricingIntro: Prices are starting points. The final quote depends on scope, features, integrations, design and timeline, and you get it in writing before work starts.
pricing.pricesPending: Prices are being finalised. Let's discuss your project and you'll get a quote for exactly what you need.
pricing.noMarketPrice: No listed price for this country yet. Ask for a quote.

notes.title: Good to know
notes.scopeBody: Number of pages and features, integrations such as payments or delivery, custom design, content, and how soon you need it.
notes.hostingBody: The first six months of domain and hosting are included. After that, renewals are paid by you, at the provider's price.
notes.maintenanceBody: Bugs in the delivered scope are fixed. New features or changes to the scope are estimated separately.
notes.goalBody: Software that makes your work easier and helps your business grow. Results depend on many things, so no specific sales figures are promised.

estimator.title: Set your budget
estimator.intro: Pick a project type, then move the slider to match the scope you have in mind.
estimator.disclaimer: This is an estimate, not a final quote. The exact price is confirmed in writing after we talk about your project.
estimator.cta: Ask for a quote with this budget

pricing.onRequestBody: No listed price for this type yet. Describe your project and you get a written quote.

referral.metaDescription: Refer a business that needs a website, app or desktop software and receive a reward when the project goes ahead under the offer terms.
referral.title: Bring a project. Share the reward.
referral.intro: Know a business that needs a website, an app or desktop software? Introduce them. If the project goes ahead and meets the conditions below, you receive a reward.
referral.step1Body: Send the business's details with the form below, with their permission.
referral.step2Body: I contact them, understand the project and send a quote.
referral.step3Body: When the conditions of the offer are met, your reward is paid.
referral.rewardPerProject: for each referred project that meets the conditions
referral.noOffer: There's no referral offer for this country at the moment. You can still introduce a business through the contact page.
referral.pending: The referral offer is being finalised and will appear here soon. You can still introduce a business through the contact page.
referral.notGuaranteed: Submitting a referral doesn't guarantee a reward. A reward is due only when the conditions above are met.
referral.contactHint: Give at least an email or a phone number.
referral.consent: I confirm the business agreed to be contacted, and I accept that my details are stored to process this referral.
referral.successBody: I'll contact the business and keep you informed about the status.

contact.metaDescription: Tell me about your website, app or desktop software project. Reply by email, phone or WhatsApp.
contact.title: Let's scale your business, or build one.
contact.intro: Fill in the form, or use whichever channel suits you. Questions are welcome even if the idea is still early.
contact.name: Name
contact.contactHint: Give at least an email or a phone number.
contact.budgetHint: A range is fine, in any currency.
contact.consent: I agree that my details are stored to answer this inquiry. They are never shared or sold.
contact.successTitle: Thank you, your message was sent.
contact.successBody: You'll get an answer within a few working days.

forms.contactRequired: Give an email or a phone number.
forms.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
forms.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again, or use another contact option.
forms.network: The message couldn't be sent. Check your connection and try again.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This site collects only what is needed to answer you.
privacy.collectBody: When you send the contact or referral form: the details you type in (name, email or phone, country, and your message). No tracking cookies and no advertising tools are used.
privacy.useBody: Only to reply to your inquiry or process your referral. Your details are never sold or shared for marketing.
privacy.keepBody: Inquiries and referrals are kept while they are being handled, then archived or deleted on request.
privacy.rightsBody: You can ask to see, correct or delete your details at any time through the contact page.
privacy.cookiesBody: The site uses no tracking or advertising cookies. One cookie remembers your language choice when you change it.
